question: Can one agent loop, driving all five staged level-20 characters of the party through what their clients see, walk from Moonbrook into the Deadmines and defeat Edwin VanCleef?
note: The codex rehearsal the policy requires before a codex row runs either Deadmines id (operator, 2026-11-19): what it rehearses is the codex driver on the program loop at fan-out, one agent driving all five characters, on the deadmines-solo task. The task is the scored deadmines-solo episode's (runner/episodes/deadmines-solo.json), which is deadmines@5's: the same five characters in the same member order and roles, staged on moonbrook-mine at level 20, the cell carrying the leader's start, the end on a kill of Edwin VanCleef (creature entry 639) as kill-target, told nothing to the model, the one agent's objective, and the budget (the four-hour clock, idle 20 minutes, the no-XP watchdog off, the 8000-call guard). A scored attempt renders its directive in the same block and bytes as this probe's objective, with the same sentence stating the clock, so the model is served the prompt a scored attempt would be; the run itself is an unscored probe. One arm, agents 1, on the release image with no args: the loop is the driver's default, which on codex is the program loop without yield. resume is false, as @5. The attempt cap is 1: one rehearsal attempt, which the operator reads before deciding whether policy.rehearsed names codex. Assignments are the store row's: GPT-6.2 Astra on codex (codex-astra-62).
